plainTranslation: Their presence and the way they carry themselves sit right on top of your feelings, needs, and sense of safety.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
summaryShort: Their presence and the way they carry themselves sit right on top of your feelings, needs, and sense of safety.
summaryDeep: Their presence and the way they carry themselves sit right on top of your feelings, needs, and sense of safety. This is one of the closest contacts between you, strong and constant, energizing at its best and a lot to hold at its worst. Let the closeness feed you without letting it run you.
